image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tabby cat sleeping on white bedding. The cat's head is the primary focus, showing closed eyes and distinct facial markings. The body extends towards the top right, partially out of frame. A small portion of a paw or leg is visible in the bottom left corner.

The very tip of the right ear blends slightly into the background/shadows with less defined edge sharpness compared to the left ear, suggesting minor boundary ambiguity.
